headline: Base Fighting Shifts Across Several Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the struggle still concentrated on a handful of contested fronts, with several changes since the previous edition. Callums Cape remains the busiest district, advancing from 46 to 48 recorded base events in 24 hours and registering two in the latest two-hour window; its holdings stand at three Wardens, four Colonials and none neutral. Linn Mercy has risen from 30 to 34 daily events, including seven in two hours, while its eleven bases remain divided between nine Colonials, one Warden and one neutral site. Weathered Expanse has climbed from 24 to 30 daily events and logged six in the latest two hours, with five Warden, two Colonial and two neutral positions. Mooring County is up from 35 to 37 events, though no action appears in the latest two-hour slice; Wardens hold nine of twelve bases. Marban Hollow remains divided three-three with two neutral, its 20 daily events unchanged and its latest two hours quiet. Linn Mercy and Weathered Expanse show cooling casualty rates, while Callums Cape and Mooring County continue to record heavy losses and enlistment activity.
